facts.claim: [Lake Como, nearest official station: Milan] The WMO World Weather Information Service gives Milan climatological normals for 1971-2000, supplied by the Italian Air Force Department of Meteorology: August mean daily minimum 17.6 C, mean daily maximum 28.5 C, mean total rainfall 88.8 mm, mean number of rain days 7.1. Milan is a city station, not on Lake Como itself.
